hypotheses.latent_object: F(t)=the real-valued function on the real axis proposed to satisfy F(t)=Im(polygamma(0, 1/2 + I*t)) and F(t)=(pi/2)*tanh(pi*t)
hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: G0001 and G0002 are the two catalog expressions proposed as instances of the same latent function F(t) under the substitution t=y. G0003 is the pointwise difference G0001 - G0002 of those two instances.
required_assumptions: 1/2 + I*y is not a nonpositive integer (so polygamma(0, ·) is defined)
tanh has no poles on the real axis
proof_obligations: G0003(y) = 0 follows only if G0001 and G0002 both denote the same F(y)
hypotheses.rationale: The current expression is exactly the difference of the two catalog members. The nontrivial structural hypothesis is that both members are instances of a single latent real-valued function on the real axis, in which case their difference would vanish. This is stated as an exact proof obligation rather than a certified zero result.
